nodes.text: Fill out this form for me... I'm just going to do a last minute inspection on the pumpkins you have on the float.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Inspection?

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Nothing big. Just a safety check!

nodes.text: Sure! Go right ahead!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: You take your time filling out that form, and I'll take my time with the pumpkins...

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Inspecting them, I mean.

nodes.text: Yup! Sounds good!
A few moments later, Jeremy blows a whistle, getting the attention of all the float builders.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: All right! The parade is starting! Everyone get to your places!
The Troublemakers scramble around to finish up their float!

nodes.speaker: Paige

nodes.text: Now help me spackle!

nodes.speaker: Owen

With the last details added to the float, Paige, Kimi, and Owen board the back, while Erik hops into the front seat.

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Oww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen falls to the ground! Big Jon looms over him, cracking his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: You leave when we say you leave.
Owen cowers!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah! I leave when you say you leave!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Man, have you gotten soft... Get up!
Owen slowly rises, his head throbbing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The answer's no...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you guys doing here?

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Is that how you greet old friends?

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Yeah!
Owen pulls them aside, down a small alley away from the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's how I greet the punk who's been bothering me since he showed up! Now what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Easy, man. Maybe we just came by to say hi.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Or something.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, it's the 'or something' I'm worried about. You've got two seconds.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Sounds like a threat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It is a threat.
Big Jon reaches his hand out and shoves Owen back.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Nobody threatens us.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't touch me. Touch me again, and you'll be sorry.
He turns to Dom.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Get to the point. `Now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Get to the point. [color=#e23b3b][i]Now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Fine. Fine. There's a score coming up. We need you `driving` just like you did back--
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Fine. There's a score coming up. We need you [color=#e23b3b][i]driving[/i][/color] just like you did back--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm outta here.
Owen starts to head back for the float, when Big Jon grabs him, spinning him around, and throwing a punch at Owen's head!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Seriously. I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fine. Lie to me!
Nate slaps a pumpkin off the top of the float. It crashes into one of the Cromwell figures.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Not cool!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That was my favorite Cromwell!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nate, you'd better pick that up!
But Nate keeps walking away. Owen rushes after him! Nate spins around!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What are you gonna do, huh?
Over Nate's shoulder, Owen sees two members of his old 12th Street crew, Dom and Big Jon.
They're pointing and laughing at some of the other floats.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm gonna do nothing...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I thought so.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...But only because I've got worse scum to deal with.
Owen brushes past Nate and approaches Dom and Big Jon angrily...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Over there? I don't see him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's where he said he'd be. Something about needing some space and being really dry.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe there's a drinking fountain over there?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I don't see one...
Nate heads over to the orange fence... When he gets there, he turns around, facing Owen.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: There's nothing here!
Just then, another wall of water spills out over the orange fence, soaking Nate from head to toe!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I might have been mistaken.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You son of a--
Nate doesn't finish the thought, marching away in embarrassment and rage.
Owen smiles, but the smile quickly fades.
In the crowd, he spots two members of his old 12th Street crew, Dom and Big Jon.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are they doing here?
He approaches them angrily...
Just then the crowd shifts, knocking into Cameron! He stumbles forward, and $ALLISON stops him, her hands on his chest. She blushes.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Nice catch, $ALLISON. Saved my life.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What? You weren't in any danger. Unless you somehow flew past me, but even then in order to suffer any injuries you'd have to bend the laws of physics--

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wait... You were being sarcastic, weren't you?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, you caught on faster than usual.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe I'm getting used to you!
Suddenly Veronica comes storming up, a wicked smile on her face!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: You're so dead meat! I caught you!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You caught me... What?

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: I caught you hitting on my guy!
Veronica quickly flashes a picture of $ALLISON looking up at Cameron with her hands on his chest.
She slides her finger across her phone a few times, and it chirps out a series of sounds.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: And now it's all over Faceplace that you're nothing but a man-stealing, trashy--

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: --You put that picture up on Faceplace?!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Stop interrupting, Cam! I'm trying to get my revenge here!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, at my expense!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Not only are you using me, you're also completely wrong!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: $ALLISON wasn't hitting on me or trying to steal me from you! She just caught me from falling over! We're just friends!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Yeah, did you not see the picture? This isn't how you look at a `friend!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, did you not see the picture? This isn't how you look at a [color=#3b78e2][i]friend![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Veronica turns to $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Let's get one thing crystal clear, $ALLISON! Cam's not into you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: When a guy's into you, `he does stuff for you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: When a guy's into you, [color=#3b78e2][i]he does stuff for you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: He buys you coffee, he drives you where you want to go, he holds your stuff for you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It sounds like he's your servant.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: He's practically my boyfriend!
Cameron scowls, skulking off.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I can't believe you.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Cam?! Cam, wait!
Veronica follows after him, managing to slip in one last angry glare at $ALLISON before disappearing around the corner.
Back on the float, as Owen loads a container of pumpkins, Nate approaches.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do `you` want?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] want?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look. I get that you're mad because of the whole Steelman Program incident with Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I framed him, and it was really `really` low. But I'm here to make amends.
nodes.text_bbcode: I framed him, and it was really [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] low. But I'm here to make amends.

nodes.text: Nearby, Owen sees a large wave of water spill out over an `orange fence` from the carnival's water ride. The wave nearly drenches an unsuspecting girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nearby, Owen sees a large wave of water spill out over an [b]orange fence[/b] from the carnival's water ride. The wave nearly drenches an unsuspecting girl.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Something funny about me trying to apologize?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, uh, it's just, nothing...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, you'd better be careful. Spencer makes amends by punching people in the face.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm prepared to accept that. Sort of. But you gotta understand, I'm competitive. I want to win.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I got my priorities wrong, but I would `never` do something like that again.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I got my priorities wrong, but I would [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] do something like that again.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Spencer and I are teammates... And teammates are forever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure teammates are for as long as the team is together. That's like, one season.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: We'll remember it forever. And I don't want to remember my high school times as the times I betrayed a teammate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Can you help me, Owen? Can you help me fix things with Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think you can be forgiven for what you did, Nate. Not by me and not by Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't `want` to help you. But if I did and Spencer found out, he'd probably 'make amends' with me too.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to help you. But if I did and Spencer found out, he'd probably 'make amends' with me too.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, can you at least just tell me where he is?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, I don't know where he went. I don't think anyone does.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Seriously, dude. Where is he?

options.label: He's over by that orange fence.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh, heh... It's like the candle from that cartoon movie.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I love that movie.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Don't tell anyone, but I do too.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure I said the `candle's` beautiful.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm pretty sure I said the [color=#e23b3b][i]candle's[/i][/color] beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, but in your story it's very clear that `I'm` the real candle.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, but in your story it's very clear that [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the real candle.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, can we not talk about this?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not sure why we would change topics at this point, but...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: ...I'm going to be making a float that's a thousand times better than anything your misfit crew can make!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: And then everyone will realize just how talentless you are compared to me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, well, you're kind of crazy right now, so I'm going to go back to my float now.
Kimi slinks away. When she returns to the float...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Brinna.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh, you're sorry?! That makes me feel `so` much better! I'm happy to know that you're sorry!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you're sorry?! That makes me feel [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much better! I'm happy to know that you're sorry!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: While you're standing there feeling sorry...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Stop being such a drama queen, Brinna.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Drama queen?! `Drama queen?!` Is that what you call someone who's dedicated themselves to getting even?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Drama queen?! [color=#3b78e2][i]Drama queen?![/i][/color] Is that what you call someone who's dedicated themselves to getting even?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, I'm pretty sure you call that person a psycho.
The comment flusters Brinna, so she moves on...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! I draw the line at looking like a hideous bird in front of everyone I know!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: So then you are prepared to accept the consequences, yes?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm prepared. I don't care what you do, I'm `not` wearing that!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm prepared. I don't care what you do, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] wearing that!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Excellent! I'll let Ms. Lee know right away!
In Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And `then` he actually tried to make me wear--
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]then[/i][/color] he actually tried to make me wear--

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Paige, but I'm less interested in this...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And more interested in... Anything else.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All I know is that I told you to obey Cromwell, and according to him you did not.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, but--

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: There are no 'buts' out of this! No 'buts' at all! He's your friend, and because of that I trust him!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's not my friend!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I know he's your friend, because he said that you'd say that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! How does that make him my friend?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: He obviously knows you better than you know yourself. You should be grateful to have someone who cares about you so much!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Incidentally, without any other avenues for punishing you, I'm forced to expel you from Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Expel me?! That's ridiculous! There must be something you can do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please, Ms. Lee, just one more chance!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm afraid you're all out of chances... Two strikes, and you're out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's three strikes!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, then you're really out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I meant...
Paige sees the hopelessness of the situation before her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Never mind...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Clear out your locker.
Ms. Lee hands her a slip of paper and escorts her out of the office.
Later, as Paige is leaving Twin Branches, she takes one last look back...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No more fights in the halls, no more fights in the classroom, no more fights with Owen...
And she realizes that the life she was once leading has now been extinguished...
She realizes that...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm glad to see we're all getting along! Cromwell will be in charge today!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ms. Lee, him?! `Him?!` The guy who swore a crazy family revenge oath against me is... Is my boss for the day?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ms. Lee, him?! [color=#e23b3b][i]Him?![/i][/color] The guy who swore a crazy family revenge oath against me is... Is my boss for the day?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, you two know each other? That's so sweet! Make sure to do everything he says...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: ...He's very rich! And rich people must be right! How else would they have gotten wealthy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know if that's completely logic--

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anyway, time to find a date for the night... Or some nachos... Whichever happens first! Bye now!
Ms. Lee giddily hurries away, leaving the Troublemakers with Cromwell.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Hello, Troublepeople! There are seven floats in the Harvest Festival parade. This one will be the best.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, we're not working for you. You're a sleaze bucket.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You fought dirty against Owen, `and` you have bad hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: You fought dirty against Owen, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] you have bad hair!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And you seem really charismatic in a way that I find off-putting!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I do not know how to react to this last one, but I do remember what Ms. Lee said about ten seconds ago.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I have lots and lots of money. And you are all under punishment, like school prison. Especially Paige.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: So you will all do `exactly` as I say. `Especially Paige.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So you will all do [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] as I say. [color=#e23b3b][i]Especially Paige.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Worst. Day. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Not yet... But soon enough.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: This paper-mache figure of me... It is not big enough.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We just finished making five of them!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: So then you know how to make them proper-sized this time, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grrr!
And after making the figure bigger...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: There! That is the proper-sized me! But it is not handsome enough.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If anything, this plain, messy lump is more attractive than you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Not a funny joke. But you're right, it is too plain. Put the paint on it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why did I say anything?
And after adding a coat of paint to the figure...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I don't like this color... It does not really say `Cromwell`, don't you think?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't like this color... It does not really say [color=#e23b3b][i]Cromwell[/i][/color], don't you think?

nodes.text: Paige's outfit, her skin, `her hair` is all speckled with gobs of paint.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige's outfit, her skin, [b]her hair[/b] is all speckled with gobs of paint.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, what color do you want it to be?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What colors did I have you get from the paint store?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Blue, green, and red.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then I think purple would be truly fabulous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So then I'll combine the blue and the red. That makes purple.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Hmmm... I don't think so. I'd prefer it if it came from the store purple.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Urg! Whatever!
And finally...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That is a handsome version of me! Make the rest just like this one!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The rest?! No way! I'm not making any more of these ugly Cromwell figures!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then, I can tell Ms. Lee you refused?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr! Fine! I'll make more.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: This brings me to my favorite part of today, the moment I have been waiting for since I woke up!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I think you have not been painting with much fun, much life, much joy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can't make me smile!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: No, I cannot. But I can make `me` smile... So I am going to make you create the Cromwells wearing this!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I cannot. But I can make [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] smile... So I am going to make you create the Cromwells wearing this!

nodes.text: Cromwell reaches inside the truck and pulls out a ridiculous-looking turkey suit!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It'll be your outfit when you're on the float too, for all to see!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no! No way! I am `not` wearing that! Not in public, not ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! No way! I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] wearing that! Not in public, not ever!

nodes.text: Cromwell has a conversation with an imaginary Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Can you believe it, Ms. Lee? She refused to cooperate with my request. I guess you'll have to expel her from the school.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Keeping in mind of course that I funded the entire event out of the upper class kindness of my heart.
His voice raises in pitch.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Oh, Cromwell, you are so handsome. And so rich. Paige was a fool to treat you so poorly.
He returns his gaze to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh my! Oh my goodness! Spencer! My darling Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: How could such a thing happen?! Life isn't fair! It isn't!
Ms. Lee takes Spencer's other hand in hers and sobs, wiping her nose with it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, Ms. Lee, could I get my hand back?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Of course! You'll need all the working limbs you can get!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know I'll be able to walk again eventually, right?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I know, I know...
The rest of the Troublemakers file in...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Spencer, buddy...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Weirdo.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You look... Better than I thought you would.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks... I think?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know that this was like a super tragic moment and all but you should have seen yourself, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You were just flying across the pumpkin patch! And you were like a streak! A flash! And I just...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry... It was awesome! And tragic too, but also `so` awesome!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry... It was awesome! And tragic too, but also [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] awesome!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right. Maybe someone caught it on their phone...
The Troublemakers spend the rest of their night there, by Spencer's side...
At school the next day, the Troublemakers assemble in Ms. Lee's office. Everyone is tired and sad, and Ms. Lee looks like she's been crying all night...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm afraid I have terrible news, kids...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The Harvest Festival disaster has brought a lot of attention on this school's experimental program...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The powers that be are sure that at least one of you `intentionally` caused the float to crash into that prized pumpkin.
nodes.text_bbcode: The powers that be are sure that at least one of you [color=#3b78e2][i]intentionally[/i][/color] caused the float to crash into that prized pumpkin.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! That's ridiculous! Why would we destroy our `own` float?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! That's ridiculous! Why would we destroy our [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] float?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why would we ruin a perfect pumpkin specimen?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Or nearly kill $ALLISON?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I know it's an unfair judgment, but a few weeks ago, I would have been just like them. They don't know you like I do.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: To them, you're a bunch of troublemakers who were all pulling some kind of elaborate, dangerous prank!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: To make matters worse... They found some cherry bombs inside the pumpkins on the float...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Which means someone is `really` out to get you guys...
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means someone is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] out to get you guys...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So... So what are the ramifications?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I am deeply sad to say that the Troublemakers program will be canceled effective tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! Then what does that mean for us?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Since most of you still haven't served out your sentences, and since there's no longer a way to do so, it means you'll all be...
Ms. Lee chokes up trying to get the words out...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You'll all be...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: ...Expelled!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't mention it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No. Spencer...
$ALLISON holds Spencer's hand, forcing him to look right into her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No one's ever done anything like that for me, ever. You saved my life by risking yours. Thank you `so` much.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one's ever done anything like that for me, ever. You saved my life by risking yours. Thank you [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just so you know, I'd do it again...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You would?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd do just about anything for you...
$ALLISON leans forward to give Spencer a kiss on the cheek, when Ms. Lee bursts into the room!
Spencer closes his eyes, his fists balling up at his sides.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How can you say something like that?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What do you mean? I was merely stating a preference I have.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't you know me enough yet?! Don't you know that's not what I want to hear right now?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, I guess I don't know that. I apologize... It's just... This situation is so new to me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well it's new to me too! The last thing I need is someone reminding me that my `entire future` is ruined!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well it's new to me too! The last thing I need is someone reminding me that my [color=#e23b3b][i]entire future[/i][/color] is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That isn't what I was saying, Spencer. I was merely stating that--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know what you were merely stating! Drop it, okay!
$ALLISON can see tears starting to form in Spencer's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay... I'm sorry...
Ms. Lee bursts into the room!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've never been more happy for an interruption! That was so awkward!
But suddenly Nate is there, leaping through the air at top speed!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He pushes $ALLISON out of the way just in time!
The truck slams into the pumpkin! It explodes in a shower of orange-colored guts!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `So.` Gross.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So.[/i][/color] Gross.

nodes.text: Spencer's view of $ALLISON is blocked by the truck!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON! Are you okay?!
He runs as fast as he can around the float, his heart pounding, his mind set on just one thing... `Her safety!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He runs as fast as he can around the float, his heart pounding, his mind set on just one thing... [b]Her safety![/b]

nodes.text: And when he turns the corner, nothing can prepare him for the sight of Nate kissing $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You saved my life!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It was nothing. Just another heroic day for the Nate-ster.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't understand this name, but I don't care. Just keep kissing me... Hero.
$ALLISON pulls him in for another kiss, and Spencer's heart drops.
He knows how kissably close he was to being that guy...
He knows how Frenchably far away he is now...
He knows...
Later that day, in the hospital...
The Troublemakers are all huddled together once again, but this time outside Spencer's hospital room.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I hope he's all right...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know what happened... The steering wheel didn't turn... The brakes didn't work...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's okay, Erik. It wasn't your fault.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guys, it's going to be okay. The doctor's going to come out of his room any second, and she'll tell us Spencer's going to be fine.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He's a football player. He's tough. He's going to be... Fine...
Paige reaches over and takes Owen's hand...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course he is.
A loud, angry scream, unmistakably Spencer's, comes from inside the adjacent room.
A moment later, the doctor emerges.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What happened? Is he okay?

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Considering the fact that he just got ran over by a truck, I'd say he's lucky to have escaped with his life...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then why did he just scream?! What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I had to inform Mr. Cooper that his leg's been broken pretty badly.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: He wanted to know if he'd be able to play football this year...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: But that's completely out of the question, given the severity of his injury.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, can we go in to cheer him up?

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: You can go in, but I wouldn't recommend it. He's not in a very friendly state.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Spencer's never really been in a friendly state.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Then by all means... You know what's best for him emotionally.
As the team starts to head in...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Guys... If it's all right with you, I'd like to see him first, alone.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure... We'll be right outside...
$ALLISON quietly steps into Spencer's hospital room out of his field of vision. He's lying in the bed, his leg suspended in a sling above him.
The door thumps when $ALLISON closes it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I thought I told you I wanted to be left alone!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's me, Spencer...
$ALLISON comes around to the side of the bed, into view...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh... $ALLISON!
Spencer tries to sit up, momentarily forgetting about his leg. He winces.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ow! Dumb! Dumb!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, don't move. Here.
She reaches over and fluffs a pillow for him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I got it! You don't have to do that...
$ALLISON backs off, and Spencer's expression softens.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, not really. I was almost crushed by that truck... And then, and then suddenly I wasn't, but `you` were.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, not really. I was almost crushed by that truck... And then, and then suddenly I wasn't, but [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] were.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I ran as fast as I could...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know you did. I... I just wanted to say...
...Does nothing! His legs simply stop as the impossible and tragic is about to play out before him!
...Does nothing! His legs simply stop as the impossible and tragic is about to play out before him!
Spencer leaps through the air, knocking $ALLISON out of the path of the float truck...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Grr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grr![/i][/color]

nodes.text: But Spencer himself isn't completely clear of the truck's path!
It slams into his leg!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `YAAAAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YAAAAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The world flashes white...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Spencer!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Spencer![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...Does nothing! His legs simply stop as the impossible and tragic is about to play out before him!
Spencer summons a reserve of strength he didn't know he had...
He's spurred on by adrenaline and by the thought of what will happen if he doesn't get there!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on!
He runs through the crowd, crosses the road, and leaps over the fence, right where $ALLISON is!
But the truck is upon them! Time seems to slow to a crawl!
Spencer drives forward, and...
In this critical moment, Spencer... Does nothing!
He freezes up, too nervous from the pressure!
He watches as the impossible and tragic begins to play out before him...
Without thinking, Spencer takes off toward $ALLISON!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr!
He crosses the road!
The truck slams into the fence...
`SMASH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SMASH![/b]

nodes.text: ...The wooden fence pieces crumble like twigs underneath the weight of the float!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! No no no no no!
$ALLISON spins toward the float, but she looks frozen with surprise!
Spencer doesn't even move, calling $ALLISON's name out from afar!
Only later does he think that he should run after her!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What am I doing standing around?!
As the float barrels straight at $ALLISON, Spencer feels a rush of sad adrenaline... Of guilt... And of pain!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Peculiar behavior...
Realizing he's not there to supervise anymore, $ALLISON resumes hopping the fence.
She lands on the other side and gets into position near the large pumpkin.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is perfect!
Meanwhile, Mr. Horner stands with his daughter at a podium on a big outdoor stage. He gestures at the approaching float parade.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Yup. Thanks for coming. Here's the parade.
Delilah steps up to the mic to make an announcement of her own.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hey, Erik! I lit `one` lantern for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Erik! I lit [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] lantern for you!

nodes.text: Inside the truck, Erik hears Delilah's message.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! One if by land! The Erik is coming! The Erik is coming!
The trucks approach the bend in the road. Erik starts to turn the wheel...
...But nothing happens! The float doesn't turn!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Come on, Truck. Turn now.
He turns the wheel more, but the truck stays straight, leaving the road and bouncing hard on the dirt!
The rest of the Troublemakers call out from the back of the truck!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're knocking all my feathers loose!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We just lost a pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Slow down, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm trying! I'm trying!
Erik presses down on the brakes, but nothing happens!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh oh!
The downhill slope of the hill causes the truck to speed up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhhhhhh! Runaway truck! Runaway truck!
Spencer is approaching the floats when...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhhhhhh! Runaway truck! Runaway truck!
The truck careens toward a wooden fence, which is right in front of the Harvest Festival's prized pumpkin, and in between them is...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...$ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: One of me?
Jeremy's posture suddenly straightens.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Well, okay. Just make it quick, and then take your pictures...

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: But you'd better take the pictures of the float soon!
$ALLISON snaps a couple pictures of Jeremy.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: These are... Excellent representations of how you look.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Thank you! I'm... Kind of an amateur model.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh-huh. So... Why should I take my pictures soon?

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Uh, no reason! That's just a thing people say! Seize the moment!
Jeremy hurries off!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: I'm not saying that you can't take pictures...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, but I thought--

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: If you listened, you'd know I said that you shouldn't be here!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: It's against the Harvest Festival rules! Now I'm going to have to ask you to move.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: You can take pictures with the rest of the people over there.
Jeremy nods to a big crowd.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Over there? But it'll be hard to get a clear shot...

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Tough. Now, I, uh, I have to be going.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Fine... I'll move.
Jeremy looks at the floats, which are coming closer...

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Oh, it's about to happen! I gotta go!
He takes off running!
Spencer stands in line at the balloon dart game. In front of him, a little boy weakly throws his dart at the wall of balloons... It falls to the dirt harmlessly.

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Did I win?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Duh, kid. You didn't pop a balloon, you don't win.

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Oh...
Spencer steps up, dropping down a few dollars.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: That gets you three throws. Pop one balloon, you win a...
Spencer hurls a dart at the wall!
`POP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]POP![/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That was for all the big, dumb words I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Uh, that gets you a bubble toy--
Spencer picks up a second dart...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is for... For... How angry I'm feeling!
He throws it at the wall!
`POP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]POP![/b]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Uh, that's two. Now you can get a plastic bear.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And this is for all the girls who ever said they just wanted to be my friend!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Uh, sure, man. Whatever--
Spencer throws the last dart at the wall in a flash!
`POP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]POP![/b]

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Whoa! You're a superhero!
Spencer marches away...

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Don't you want your prize? You can get a fuzzy animal!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pick something for yourself, kid.

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Really?! Thanks!
A voice over the PA system calls out the start of the float parade.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoops! Lost track of time...
Spencer starts hurrying back to the grandstand...
Out in front of the float parade, $ALLISON looks for a place to take the perfect pictures...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I want to make sure I'll be able to catch the float in truly idyllic light...
Her eyes settle on a large pumpkin up for display on the other side of a wooden fence.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Perfect! As the floats turn this corner, I'll get a lot of contrasting shadows!
She hustles over to the fence, climbs it, and--

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: You shouldn't be here!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! You startled me!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Civilians aren't allowed in this area.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I just want to take a couple pictures...

options.label: I'll even take one of you.
There's not much harm in that.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: If that's your answer, then we have to tell you plan B.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine. What's plan B?

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Plan B is... You refuse, we make you regret refusing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that a threat?

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: It is.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, you guys go do whatever illegal, dumb score you've got cooked up. But stay away from me!
Owen marches away. As he marches, Dom calls out to him...

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: That's how it's gonna be?! You're making a mistake! We warned you!
But Owen keeps walking...
Back at the float...
Jeremy, the event coordinator is making the rounds, clipboard in hand.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: You guys from Twin Branches ready?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: And you're going to be driving the float, is that correct?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Also affirmative!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: You're sure?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: As affirmative as I can be!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Good. Good. That's good.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Listen, Jeremy...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know there's some icky blood between us after the whole Delilah thing...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I still think you're really cool!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Do you think I care what you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The way you said that makes me think... No.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: She was `mine,` and you took her from me!
nodes.text_bbcode: She was [color=#e23b3b][i]mine,[/i][/color] and you took her from me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hahaha! You're talking about her like she's a thing and not a person! That's really funny!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh wait... You're serious, huh?

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: She was mine!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jeremy, Delilah never belonged to you, and she doesn't belong to me now. She can't help who she likes!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Well, you made it really easy for her to like you, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What can I say? I've...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! I'll wear the dumb turkey suit! But if I see `any` of you trying to take a pic, you're dead!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! I'll wear the dumb turkey suit! But if I see [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] of you trying to take a pic, you're dead!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know me. I won't say a thing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Turkey feathers will look good on you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up. All of you.
Paige heads angrily for the restrooms, dragging the turkey suit behind her.
Meanwhile, Kimi notices who's working on the nearest float...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Brinna? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I don't know if you know this, Kimi, but I like to design things. Floats, dances, clothes--

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh wait, you do know that, because you destroyed my shot at the fashion show, and my life while you were at it.
Later that day, in the hospital...
The Troublemakers are all huddled together once again, but this time outside Spencer's hospital room.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I hope he's all right...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know what happened... The steering wheel didn't turn... The brakes didn't work...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's okay, Erik. It wasn't your fault.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guys, it's going to be okay. The doctor's going to come out of his room any second, and she'll tell us Spencer's going to be fine.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He's a football player. He's tough. He's going to be... Fine...
Paige reaches over and takes Owen's hand...

nodes.text: Twist! I won't be giving you your assignment this week! This week, it will be the Harvest Festival's main benefactor, Mr. Von Toosh!
Cromwell steps out of the truck.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Hello, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Von Toosh?! Your last name is Von `Toosh?!` It's officially too easy to make fun of you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Hello to you too, guy I beat up.

nodes.text: Annoyed to see you as always...
